title: A lithium extraction facility in Bolivia's Salar de Uyuni
author: NASA/JSC
description: iss074e0796207 (July 7, 2026) --- A lithium extraction facility in Bolivia's Salar de Uyuni, the world's largest salt flat and the flattest surface on Earth, is pictured from the International Space Station as it orbited 263 miles above the South American nation. Credit: NASA/Chris Williams
